name: 知了标讯商机作战台

description_zh: 搜索招中标项目、分析企业和竞对、查看市场与历史价格。
description_en: Search bidding opportunities, analyze companies and competitors, and inspect market and historical pricing signals.
examples_zh: 找广东近30天服务器相关、金额100万以上的招标项目
分析华为的竞争对手和主要客户
查询联想服务器近一年的中标价格
examples_en: Find server tenders in Guangdong above RMB 1M from the last 30 days
Analyze Huawei competitors and major customers
Show Lenovo server award prices from the past year
